description: This file defines the SubpanelMetaDataParser class, which extends ListLayoutMetaDataParser. It is responsible for parsing, managing, and saving subpanel layout metadata in the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM module builder environment. It includes methods for retrieving default fields, handling invisible fields, saving layout changes, and formatting relate fields as links.

classes.name: SubpanelMetaDataParser
classes.description: A parser class for handling subpanel metadata, including retrieving, modifying, and saving subpanel layout definitions within SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser, loads view definitions and field definitions, and determines invisible fields based on subpanel configurations.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the current layout, optionally populating from request data and handling label updates.

methods.name: getDefaultFields
methods.description: Returns the default query fields for the subpanel layout.

methods.name: findInvisibleFields
methods.description: Finds fields marked as 'query_only' in the view definitions that are not visible but used internally.

methods.name: restoreInvisibleFields
methods.description: Restores invisible fields into the view definitions.

methods.name: _trimFieldDefs
methods.description: Static method to trim and normalize field definitions, particularly converting labels to 'vname'.

methods.name: makeRelateFieldsAsLink
methods.description: Formats relate fields to be displayed as links in the subpanel view by adding widget class and target info.
